column8: ["Give the broad teal housing richer pools of glaze and sharper chipped edges; its mottling currently blends into a soft, uniform surface.","Deepen the seat rims with dark inner walls and selective glazed highlights so the openings feel cut through substantial ceramic.","Develop the brass fittings with clearer patina, bright worn edges and contact shadows to make them feel embedded and tangible.","Give the brown inset strips distinct rubber texture and worn lips; their material currently reads ambiguously."]
